title: Best red wine sangria!!
text: The best sangrias we've had! The red wine sangria was particularly a favourite of mine 😁 they were all perfectly balanced. A little bit rushed through the courses but the sangrias have ruined any other ones we will have in the future as they will never be as good as these ones!
author: Sheeana G

title: Amazing Experience!
text: It was a great choice to choose this experience to enjoy Seville! Tasty Sangria and delicious tapas, but the best was our wise host.
author: C746SRjamest

title: Wonderful Experience
text: A wonderful experience!!!! The tapas were exquisite and the sangrias the best I have ever tasted, and that I visit Spain frequently. Our guide was very friendly and wise. Thank you so much for everything!!!
author: martadF4146OM

title: This has to be in your bucket list
text: This trip was for our 5 year wedding anniversary with my husband. The Sangria tasting with a great view is a must experience when in Spain and most especially in Andalucia.
author: Arlene_C
